# Introduction

This vignette shows how to create a SummarizedExperiment object from a CellRanger output, 
i.e. a file named `raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5`.

The important steps are: 

1. load the counts stored into the h5 using `DropletUtils::read10xCounts`

2. set rownames to unique gene symbol

3. pre-compute QC metrics and sizeFactors

4. store object into desired format 



# Load Cellranger count


```{r,message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

## Load from h5
```{r,message=FALSE}

x <- DropletUtils::read10xCounts("apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE224407/GSE224407_RAW/GSM7021828_E19_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
rownames(x) <- make.unique(mcols(x)$Symbol)
```


## Compute QC metrics and librarySize
```{r}
BPPARAM <- BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(6L,progressbar = TRUE)
x <- scater::addPerCellQC(x,BPPARAM=BPPARAM)
x <- scuttle::computeLibraryFactors(x,BPPARAM=BPPARAM)
```


## Save object
```{r}
HDF5Array::saveHDF5SummarizedExperiment(x,"datasets/GSE224407_GSM7021828.h5se")
ABAData::writeSingleCellExperiment(x, "datasets/GSE224407_GSM7021828.h5txt")
```
